Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original raster video-game title logo with true transparent alpha, for a sci-fi frontier duel slot game header and intro.
Primary request: Create ONE single polished original BOUNTY BREAKERS title-logo. Exactly two words on two stacked lines: BOUNTY above BREAKERS. Custom bold outlined arcade lettering, instantly legible at a small 330 by 140 pixel display size, with the finish and dimensional craftsmanship of polished video-game key art and a subtle pixel/arcade influence. This must be an illustrated title logo, not plain typeset text.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background, alpha=0 outside the logo; no scene, no colored or white background, no checkerboard graphic, no opaque rectangle.
Composition/framing: Wide compact lockup around 2.4:1 overall aspect ratio. Both lines centered and balanced, strong readable silhouette. Entire logo fully contained; generous empty transparent safety margin on all four sides, about 8 percent. Make the logo usable at both 330x140 and 500x210. No outer glow bleeding into the safety margin.
Color palette: Top word BOUNTY in warm amber/gold; bottom word BREAKERS in icy cyan; very dark navy and chiseled dark-metal bevels and outlines. Restrained cyan electricity accents and amber bullet-like edge accents integrated into the lettering, with a very small fractured bounty-badge motif only if it helps the compact lockup.
Materials/textures: Chiseled heavy metal bevels, sharp robust letter shapes, restrained wear and small chips, bright clean letter faces. Keep surface texture subtle enough that the title remains unmistakable at small size.
Text (verbatim): "BOUNTY" on line 1; "BREAKERS" on line 2. Spell B-O-U-N-T-Y and B-R-E-A-K-E-R-S correctly. Render each word exactly once.
Constraints: One logo only. Actual PNG transparency with preserved alpha. No additional words, letters, slogan, watermark, UI, characters, guns, environment, wall, floor, frame, decorative background, or rectangle. No multiple alternatives.
